headline: Festival of the Winds 2026: splashes of colour in the sky and on the sand – in pictures
context: Under bright blue skies Bondi beach is transformed into a kaleidoscope of hues for the annual event. Founded in 1978, the Festival of the Winds is celebrated on the second Sunday of September Blankets of colour: Western Australia’s wildflower season bursts to life – in pictures C
